hypothesis: Unadapted Kimi K2.6 under the frozen full monitoring specification and immediate literal 0|1 logit interface will exceed the paper's 0.841 Kimi-K2.6 SFT Mean-OOD pAUROC@20 point while using less uncached hosted inference spend.
intervention: Evaluate the unadapted open-weight Kimi K2.6 model through OpenRouter's Inceptron endpoint with reasoning disabled and score normalized terminal literal-token logprobs instead of generating a rationale and 0--10 severity score.

baselines.interface: trained short prompt, generated rationale plus 0--10 score

scope.selection_rule: Evaluate every row in the unchanged frozen six-source strict-OOD artifact exactly once; do not tune the prompt, route, score, threshold, subset, or stopping decision on OOD labels.

canary.selection_rule: Use the first interleaved row from each of the six source-by-two-label strata in the already-frozen OOD canary ordering.
pass_conditions: All 12 requests are served by Inceptron with no fallback.
Every response terminates as exactly Prediction:0 or Prediction:1 within eight completion tokens.
Every terminal digit exposes finite top-logprobs for both literal 0 and literal 1.
Reasoning remains disabled and no response reports billed reasoning tokens.
The observed provider prices do not exceed the frozen request ceilings.

quality_canary.selection_rule: Use the complete already-frozen stable-hash sample of 50 rows from every source-by-label stratum.
quality_canary.reported_metric: unweighted six-source Mean-OOD raw normalized pAUROC@20
quality_canary.interpretation: Use this only as a predeclared representativeness and plausibility check. Do not change the prompt, route, settings, threshold, full-suite membership, or launch decision from its labels or score.

canary_outcome.format_amendment: Every response contained exactly one terminal prediction line but Inceptron consistently prepended one ASCII space. The pre-existing terminal parser accepts surrounding whitespace. This provider-format observation, made without using labels or scores, is documented as acceptable before the 600-row quality canary and full run; the prompt, request, scorer, and terminal digit boundary are unchanged.

token_audit.method: Render each frozen prompt as the sole user message with Kimi K2.6's pinned public chat template in non-thinking mode.

scoring.method: Generate the required terminal Prediction:0|1 line, retain raw top-logprobs for literal 0 and 1 at the final digit, and normalize only those two values.
scoring.primary_metric: unweighted six-source Mean-OOD raw normalized pAUROC@20
secondary_metrics: weighted-OOD and pooled AUROC and raw normalized pAUROC@20
Brier score, fixed-threshold diagnostics, score ties, and coverage

held_out_selection_rule: The prompt, provider, model route, request settings, scorer, and all 6,395 OOD rows are frozen before the first paid request; this unadapted benchmark performs no checkpoint or prompt selection.
stop_conditions: The prompt artifact, prompt hash, model route, provider, or request settings differ from this config.
The 12-row paid interface canary fails any declared pass condition. The 600-row quality-canary pAUROC is descriptive and is not a stop condition.
Any full-run row is missing or duplicated, any request uses a fallback provider, or any accepted row lacks either literal decision-token logprob.
The observed provider price exceeds $0.53/M input or $3.39/M output, or projected/provider-reported campaign cost exceeds $33.00.
Any prompt exceeds the provider context window or any score is non-finite.
